CustomField.description: Higher GPA between ABOR and SBOR.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(ABOR_GPA__c) && ISBLANK(SBOR_GPA__c ),ABOR_GPA__c, IF( ISBLANK(ABOR_GPA__c) , SBOR_GPA__c, IF( ISBLANK(SBOR_GPA__c ), ABOR_GPA__c, IF( (ABOR_GPA__c > SBOR_GPA__c) ,ABOR_GPA__c, SBOR_GPA__c ) )))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Higher GPA between ABOR and SBOR.
CustomField.label: Highest GPA
